summary.text: Swamp crab corpse is the body of the desolate beast swamp crab, kept as Gu refinement material after its soul is destroyed.

claims.text: After the fight, the desolate beast swamp crab’s humongous body presses on Dang Hun Mountain’s waist like a small mountain. The swamp crab’s soul is smashed by the mountain’s vibrations and absorbed into Dang Hun Mountain, while Gu worms living in the crab die with it. Fang Yuan orders the land spirit to preserve the corpse of the swamp crab well.
Every desolate beast is a moving treasure: the blood, fur, bones, and intestines in its body are great Gu refinement material.

Fang Yuan has no primeval stones to hand Immortal Crane Sect, but offers the swamp crab’s corpse to trade instead. The letter details the swamp crab’s blood, meat, bones, shell, and other parts alongside the Gu worms and materials he wants.

He Feng Yang reads each listed part of the desolate beast and treats the lot as a complete desolate beast corpse, guessing the earthly calamity was a desolate beast calamity and that Dang Hun Mountain destroyed the swamp crab’s soul while leaving the body whole. The transaction succeeds: Fang Yuan sells the whole swamp crab’s corpse and obtains most of what he needs.
